three.title: Three things Peter does for you
three.includedTrial: Included in every plan – try 14 days free

items.title: Remembers for you
items.text: Groceries, packing lists, birthdays. Say it and it is written down. Share the list with the people at home.

items.title: Reminds you
items.text: One message when it is time. Not twenty notifications – one, when it matters.

items.title: Calls for you
items.text: The dentist, the garage, the restaurant. Peter calls, agrees within your limits and reports back.

control.title: You decide. Always.
control.text: Peter first proposes what he will do and waits for your yes. He always says he is an assistant calling on your behalf – and he cannot use your card or your MitID.
steps: Peter proposes a plan – you say yes
He gets it done and reports back

store.title: Peter learns something new every month
store.text: Each app is one thing Peter can help with. Tap, read what it does and install it – then he sets it up together with you. All apps are included in Plus and Familie.

pricing.title: 14 days free. Then you choose.
pricing.text: Try everything for 14 days. You sign up with a card, and it is only charged once the trial ends – cancel before, and you pay nothing. Prices incl. VAT.
pricing.note: More calls than your plan? Extra calls are bought in the app. No commitment – change plan or stop every month.

s2.title: Who is at home?
s2.help: So you get the right lists from the start.

s3.title: What do you hate calling about most?
s3.help: Peter calls for you – but never before you have said yes. See how he does it.
s3.exampleNote: Example. Peter always says he is calling on your behalf and only agrees to what you have said yes to.

health.text: Hello, I am calling on behalf of Mette Jensen. She would like an appointment for a dental check-up – a morning if possible.
We have Tuesday at 9 or Wednesday at 10.30.
Thank you. I may not choose for her, so I send both times to Mette and she confirms herself.

workshop.text: Hello, I am calling for Mette Jensen. Her car needs an inspection – do you have a slot next week, and what does it cost?
Thank you. I let Mette know and she confirms the time herself.

municipality.text: Hello, I am calling on behalf of Mette Jensen about her case number 24-118. She wants to know if anything is missing from her.
We are missing a receipt – it can be sent via e-Boks.
Thank you. I write that to Mette so she sends it.

restaurant.text: Hello, I would like to book a table for four on Friday at 7 pm in Mette Jensen's name.
7 pm is full – 7.30 pm we can do.
I ask Mette about that before I say yes. I will call back.
